# DzSidebar

Collapsible navigation sidebar root component.

- **Family:** Navigation
- **Source:** `packages/core/src/components/navigation/DzSidebar.vue` · types `packages/core/src/components/navigation/DzSidebar.types.ts`
- **Compound parts:** `DzSidebarFooter`, `DzSidebarHeader`, `DzSidebarItem`, `DzSidebarSection`

| `collapsed` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | `false` | Whether the sidebar is collapsed to icon-only mode |
| `collapsedWidth` | `string \| undefined` | no | `undefined` | Collapsed sidebar width (CSS value) |
| `id` | `string \| undefined` | no | `undefined` | Unique element ID (prefer `useId()` from Vue 3.5 when auto-generated) |
| `isMobile` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | `undefined` | Externally controlled mobile state. When provided, the sidebar will not run its own matchMedia listener and will defer entirely to this prop. Use this when a parent `useSidebar` already detects the breakpoint. |
| `mobileBreakpoint` | `number \| undefined` | no | `1024` | Pixel breakpoint at or below which the sidebar enters mobile-drawer mode. Only used when the parent does not pass `isMobile`. Default 1024 (Tailwind `lg`). |
| `mobileOpen` | `boolean \| undefined` | no | `false` | Whether the mobile overlay sidebar is open |
| `portalTo` | `string \| HTMLElement \| undefined` | no | — | Portal target for the teleported layer. Added by TASK-OSS-P4-04. This component used to teleport to a hard-coded `body` with no way to redirect it — which is precisely the case an application embedding the library in a shadow root or a micro-frontend shell cannot work around. Falls back to the `DzProvider` target, then to `document.body`. |
| `position` | `"fixed" \| "static" \| undefined` | no | `"static"` | Controls how the sidebar root positions itself on desktop. - `static` (default): `relative shrink-0` — sidebar is a flex sibling of the AppShell content panel. - `fixed`: `fixed inset-y-0 left-0` — legacy positioning; content area must reserve its own offset. Mobile drawer behavior (when `mobileOpen` is true and `isMobile` is true) overrides position to `fixed` regardless. |
| `storageKey` | `string \| undefined` | no | `undefined` | Persist the collapsed state to `localStorage` under this key. Hydrates from storage on mount (when running in the browser). No-op during SSR or when storage is unavailable. |
| `width` | `string \| undefined` | no | `undefined` | Expanded sidebar width (CSS value) |

## Usage (from `packages/core/stories/navigation/DzSidebar.stories.ts`, story `Default`)

```vue

      <div style="height:32rem;display:flex;background:var(--dz-background);">
        <DzSidebar v-bind="args">
          <DzSidebarHeader>
            <span style="font-weight:600;color:var(--dz-sidebar-foreground-hover);">Datazup</span>
          </DzSidebarHeader>
          <DzSidebarSection title="Workspace">
            <DzSidebarItem :active="true">Dashboard</DzSidebarItem>
            <DzSidebarItem>Sessions</DzSidebarItem>
            <DzSidebarItem>Drafts</DzSidebarItem>
          </DzSidebarSection>
          <DzSidebarSection title="Account">
            <DzSidebarItem>Profile</DzSidebarItem>
            <DzSidebarItem>Settings</DzSidebarItem>
          </DzSidebarSection>
          <DzSidebarFooter>
            <span style="font-size:var(--dz-text-xs);color:var(--dz-sidebar-foreground);">v0.1.0</span>
          </DzSidebarFooter>
        </DzSidebar>
        <div style="flex:1;padding:var(--dz-spacing-6);color:var(--dz-foreground);">Main content</div>
      </div>
    
```
